subject: Mutual Action Plan — private deployment ops orientation and topology owners
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@stellaria.ai>, Matt O'Connor <matt.oconnor@keystone.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — private deployment ops orientation and topology owners

Hi Elena / Matt —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our discussion, I pulled together a first-cut MAP for Stellaria's private deployment (VPC + on-prem burst) and want to align owners for networking, VPN handoff, IAM/KMS, and the evaluation milestones that feed into procurement/close.

Attached: redwood-map-v1.xlsx (MAP with dates + owner columns). Key asks from our side to move the timeline:
- Confirm your IAM/KMS owner who can sign the key-access design (we recommend an AWS KMS alias for initial rollout).
- Confirm the VPN validation window (2–4 hours) and a tentative maintenance window we can use for smoke tests.
- Confirm who will run the first perf eval (workload owner) so we can ship a quantization profile and batching config ahead of the run.

Proposed high-level milestones (we can tighten after owner confirmation):
1) MAP kick orientation — this week (owners confirmed)
2) Topology validation & KMS access granted — week of 06/21
3) Pilot perf eval & tuning — week of 07/05
4) Contract signature & reserved capacity booking — target 08/31

Please reply with the single point(s) of contact for: Networking/VPN, IAM/KMS, and Perf Lead. If it helps, I can share a short topology sketch during a 20-min orientation call.

Next steps: if you confirm owners today we will update the MAP and lock milestone dates.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0191

Attachment: redwood-map-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet — MAP tasks, owners, target dates)

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@stellaria.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Matt O'Connor <matt.oconnor@keystone.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@stellaria.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — private deployment ops orientation and topology owners

Laura —

Thanks for the clear MAP. Quick heads-up on our side:
- Networking/VPN: Jordan Miles (jordan.miles@stellaria.ai) is our infra lead and will own VPN setup/validation.
- IAM/KMS: I own the KMS conversation but Jordan will run the key policy tests — I can approve the alias once Jordan signs off.
- Perf Lead: Matt (cc'ed) will coordinate the workload validation with our ML infra team.

Jordan and I are comfortable with the proposed milestones; the 06/21 window for topology validation works if we schedule the VPN test on 06/22 10:00–12:00 PT. We'll need the topology sketch and the access list for the KMS test at least 48 hours prior.

Also: can you add a column to the MAP for "validation checklist" so we can tick off pre-run items?

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Infrastructure | Stellaria AI
elena.torres@stellaria.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — private deployment ops orientation and topology owners

Elena / team —

Thanks for the quick replies and for confirming Jordan as Networking lead. A few technical notes from the infra side to make the topology validation efficient:
- Topology sketch: I'll attach a short draft (topology-draft.pdf) that shows recommended subnets, NAT/egress paths, and the Redwood runtime nodes we suggest colocating in the private VPC.
- KMS: we recommend using an AWS KMS CMK with an alias redwood/stellaria-prod for the pilot. Please confirm Jordan or Elena can add the redwood service principal to the key policy for the validation window.
- VPN: for the smoke tests please allow outbound 443 from our test nodes and UDP 4500/500 if you plan to use manual IPsec tunnels. We can run an automated connectivity check that takes ~15 minutes and a perf warmup that takes ~30–45 minutes.

I'll update the MAP with a "validation checklist" column and drop a link to the sketch in the doc. If we can lock the VPN test for 06/22 10:00–12:00 PT I will schedule a short Zoom with Jordan and our infra engineer.

-Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — private deployment ops orientation and topology owners

Quick note from procurement/ops: we like the Aug 31 target for contract/commit, but need to confirm reserved capacity sizing after the pilot eval. Can we carve out a 45–60 minute follow-up on 06/24 to review the pilot perf criteria (latency p95, throughput, token cost) and agree on the sizing matrix?

If 06/24 doesn't work, propose 06/25 09:00–10:00 PT. Also we will need a CSV of expected request distribution for the pilot so the performance team can pre-configure load.

—Matt
Director, ML Ops | Keystone (partner on integration)

All —

Thanks for the quick alignment. Actions I have captured and next steps: 
- Laura/Redwood to update MAP with: validation checklist column, topology sketch link, and owner cells (by EOD). (Attachment: redwood-map-v1.xlsx updated)
- Jordan (Stellaria) to confirm VPN test slot for 06/22 10:00–12:00 PT and share the IP allowlist.
- Elena to confirm KMS alias approval; Red teams to coordinate key policy changes during validation window.
- Matt to share request-distribution CSV for pilot by 06/23 so perf can be configured.
- Proposed follow-up: 06/24 09:00 PT (45 min) to review pilot perf criteria and sizing. Laura to send calendar invite once we confirm.

Target close remains 08/31 — we will surface any schedule risks in the MAP as they come up, but the critical path is topology validation -> pilot perf.

If there are no objections I will send the updated MAP and a short calendar invite within the hour.

Best,
Laura
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-map-v1.xlsx (updated)
